component.name: Keyra
component.summary: Premium low-latency typing sound engine & real-time keyboard visualizer

description.p: Keyra is a premium, state-of-the-art desktop application that generates high-fidelity, ultra-low-latency mechanical keyboard typing sounds in real-time. Designed to enhance the typing experience, it brings a rich, responsive auditory feedback loop to any standard keyboard.

Keyra features a beautiful macOS-inspired user interface with refined glassmorphism, animated screen transitions, and a highly interactive, real-time keyboard visualizer showing physical key triggers.

ul.li: Ultra-low latency audio mixing engine developed in Rust
Highly detailed real-time mechanical keyboard visualizer (60% layout)
Modular Sound Pack loading with automatic system configurations
System tray management and autostart capabilities
Minimalist, premium macOS-style user interface built with Flutter
